integrity: The proof uses the exact shortest-path geometry of complete multipartite graphs: omitted vertices require distinct selected same-part pairs from other parts. Minimality of a size-N-1 set is reduced to the failure of every size-N-2 deletion. A separate exhaustive checker constructs the corresponding one-use geodesic resources and solves the omitted-vertex matching problem directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the N and N-1 strong-upper-geodetic thresholds, not the exact value for every complete multipartite graph.
The complete-bipartite N-1 subfamilies are covered by a separate prior exact result and are retained only as part of the full multipartite classification.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior near-maximum multipartite classifications.
title: Near-maximum strong upper geodetic dimension of complete multipartite graphs
